title.zh-CN: 长期咳喘突然加重 · 74岁男性
title.en: Acute worsening of longstanding breathlessness · man aged 74

summary.zh-CN: 长期肺病患者静息气促加重，接受治疗后仍迅速恶化；对比血气、影像与病原资料，明确安全升级和证据边界。
summary.en: A patient with longstanding lung disease worsens at rest and deteriorates despite treatment; compare gases, imaging and microbiology to assess escalation and evidentiary limits.

notes.zh-CN: 依据已发表病例改写。保留年龄、性别和临床证据；姓名为化名，医院、日历日期、职业身份细节已去除。对话、问题、评分和安全选项为教学设计，未记录的数据明确未知。

disclaimer.en: Historical case review for clinical education, not individual care or self-medication. Outcomes come from the report; undocumented physiological changes are not simulated.

text.zh-CN: 双肺间质改变、炎症及纤维化，透光度下降；右肺体积小，胸膜增厚钙化。图注另述皮下和纵隔气肿及少量气胸，正文未完整说明其时间与处理。
text.en: Bilateral interstitial abnormalities, inflammation and fibrosis with reduced aeration, a small right lung and pleural thickening/calcification. The caption additionally describes subcutaneous/mediastinal emphysema and a small pneumothorax, with timing and treatment incompletely detailed.

source.zh-CN: 原报告正文的去标识化摘要；对话措辞为教学改写。

text.zh-CN: 痰真菌培养见酵母样真菌及菌丝；另记录嗜麦芽窄食单胞菌（原文旧称嗜麦芽假单胞菌）。缺乏侵袭性真菌感染的进一步确证资料。
text.en: Sputum fungal culture showed yeast-like fungi and hyphae; Stenotrophomonas maltophilia was also reported under an older name. Further confirmation of invasive fungal infection is not provided.

source.zh-CN: 原报告正文的去标识化摘要；对话措辞为教学改写。

text.zh-CN: 白细胞10.28×10⁹/L，中性粒细胞89.8%，血红蛋白74 g/L，CRP 12.9 mg/L；恶化时BNP 364 ng/L。
text.en: WBC 10.28×10⁹/L, neutrophils 89.8%, haemoglobin 74 g/L and CRP 12.9 mg/L; BNP during deterioration was 364 ng/L.

source.zh-CN: 原报告正文的去标识化摘要；对话措辞为教学改写。

text.zh-CN: 原报告在通气、抗感染及激素等基础上加用中医药，多项干预同时变化。10日影像炎症开始吸收，3周后症状减轻并出院；CT纤维化同前。没有证据证明任何单一药物逆转纤维化。
text.en: The report added traditional medicines while respiratory support, antimicrobials and steroids were used and changed concurrently. Inflammatory opacities improved by day 10 and symptoms improved before discharge after three weeks; CT fibrosis was unchanged. The record does not prove reversal of fibrosis by any single treatment.

feedback.zh-CN: 血气已提示危险变化；痰培养不能单独区分定植和侵袭，图注异常也需核对。
feedback.en: Blood gases demonstrate dangerous deterioration; sputum culture alone cannot distinguish colonisation from invasion, and caption abnormalities require review.

knowledge.zh-CN: 这是历史病例教学。先核对当前阶段原始证据，再讨论鉴别诊断及安全计划；原报告处置不自动成为今天的推荐。
knowledge.en: This is a historical teaching case. Review evidence for the current phase before discussing differential diagnosis and a safe plan; reported care is not automatically a recommendation for current practice.

conclusion.zh-CN: 本例的可核对结局是急性炎症和症状改善、纤维化未变。
conclusion.en: The verifiable endpoint is improvement in acute inflammation and symptoms with unchanged fibrosis.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 连续血气比单次体温更能显示本次危急程度。
keyReasoning.en: Serial blood gases demonstrate severity better than a single temperature.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 单病例同时治疗不能证明中药或激素的独立效应。
keyReasoning.en: Concurrent treatment in one case cannot establish independent effects of herbs or steroids.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单例观察，不能证明某种治疗的独立疗效或普遍适用性。历史处置仅记录事实；安全决策为教学设计。
boundaries.en: This single observation cannot establish the independent efficacy or general applicability of a treatment. Historical care is recorded as fact; safety decisions are educational design.
